name: The Public Miracle
premise:
In a train station, a dropped suitcase freezes midair. A crowd sees it. Security
cameras see it. A Stability Agent at the platform edge is already turning.

objective.description: Prevent the public impossibility from becoming canonical.

anchors.name: black_notebook
anchors.description: A worn black notebook filled with your own handwriting.

anchors.name: station_map
anchors.description: Your memory of how to leave this station.

suitcase.observe_text:
The suitcase hangs in the air. Forcing gravity back would be public and
deep. A plausible support or catch gives the crowd an explanation.

attention.observe_text:
The crowd is focused on the miracle. Break that focus before applying a
physical cover.

cameras.observe_text:
Security cameras have a clear view. Human attention and camera records must
both be handled.

stability_agent.observe_text:
The Agent is about to canonize the event as evidence. A delay helps only if
you also repair witnesses and records.

platform.observe_text:
A maintenance cart with a magnetic lift sits close enough to explain a
suspended metal suitcase latch.

distract.scene_message: A platform alarm chirps. Heads turn for one precious second.
distract.system_note: Exposure layer reduced. Physical and record layers remain.
distract.discovered_rule: Final repairs are layered: attention, plausible physics, records, collateral.

magnetic_catch.scene_message: The maintenance cart hums. The suitcase latch kisses magnetic metal and has a reason to hang.

activate.scene_message: The cart magnet activates under a maintenance light. The suitcase is no longer a miracle.

desync.scene_message: The camera feeds stutter just long enough to turn the freeze into motion blur.

resume.scene_message: You force gravity to resume. The suitcase drops. The crowd gasps at the correction as much as the miracle.
resume.system_note: Public deep-rule rewrite. It completes the objective with heavy collateral.

appeal.scene_message: You request procedural review. The Agent pauses but keeps watching.

audit_entries.text:
Audit shows the Agent will canonize any unresolved layer: witnesses, physics,
or records. All three must be handled.

public_miracle.text:
This needs a layered repair: distract attention, create plausible support,
and mask records. Direct gravity is the expensive fallback.

scene_progression.message: Camera records upload the floating suitcase. The miracle becomes evidence.

hidden_rules: Public miracles require layered repair across witnesses, physics, and records.
Direct deep-rule correction can complete an objective while damaging campaign state.
